QuestInfo.name: Building a Time Machine 1: Deep Sea Janitor
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9250126##k is looking for Mainboards, which are needed to build the Time Machine.
QuestInfo.1:
Use the OS4 Shuttle located in the OSSS Secret Base 
to travel to the #b#m502010200##k.

You must destroy the Space Ship parts located throughout the deep sea

and bring back 10 Mainboards #b#i04032708:##k.
QuestInfo.2: You retrieved the Mainboards required for the Time Machine.

0.0: Mainboards are vital for building time machines. Get some for us. You should be able to find them around the spaceship crash sites in the Deep Sea.
0.1: Use the OS4 Shuttle in the Hangar to get there. Now, when you arrive at the Deep Sea, you'll be wearing the OS3D Diving Suit.
0.2: Since the water there is so polluted, you cannot take off the suit! \r\nIt's equipped with weapons, so if aliens show up, fight them!

yes.0: Hurry up before the Mainboards rust...

1.0: The Mainboards are in decent condition. Good. Excellent. Whew.

yes.0: But perhaps you should wash that suit. It reeks!

item.0: I told you! Ten Mainboards! Ten!
